plan.design: 1) Score all 904 candidates with run_model rank_candidates (E1). 2) Under a monotone Gaussian error model, argmax-probability is monotone in prediction, so query the top-20 predicted lines from the evidence oracle (20 <= budget). 3) Compare E3 measured values with E1 predictions.
controls: Same trait (GRWT100), same candidate set of 904 lines, same model revision. Within-queried-line Spearman between E1 prediction and E3 measurement
comparison of the model rank-1 line's measured value against the other queried lines.
plan.observation_metric: Measured GRWT100 (g/100 grains) per queried line; Spearman(predicted, measured) among queried lines; measured max and its margin over the runner-up; posterior mass of unqueried lines above the observed max.
plan.refutation_condition: The hypothesis is refuted if among the queried top-20 predicted lines Spearman(predicted, measured) <= 0, or if the model rank-1 predicted line's measured GRWT100 is not the maximum among all 20 queried lines while a much lower-ranked predicted line holds the maximum.

revision: H1 (supported) is refined to H1': IRIS_313.12254 has the highest measured GRWT100 among the 904 candidates, with measured 5.0 g versus runner-up IRIS_313.12349 at 4.7 g. This claim remains probabilistic because 884 candidates were never phenotyped; under a calibration fitted to the 20 measurements the expected number of unqueried lines above 5.0 g is ~0.00-0.08 and P(no unqueried line exceeds 5.0) is approximately 0.93-1.00 across reasonable sensitivity assumptions.
reason: All 20 oracle measurements were obtained. Spearman(predicted, measured) = 0.473 > 0, and the model rank-1 line (IRIS_313.12254) held the highest measured value (5.0 g). Neither refutation clause was triggered.

plan.design: exp-1 (E1): run_model(rank_candidates, all 904 candidate ids) to get a model ranking. exp-2 (E3): query the oracle for the top-20 predicted lines (the set maximizing, under a monotone-likelihood error model, the probability the measured argmax is observed within a 20-query budget).
controls: model trained on the 60% training split only (seed 20261029), never on the candidate pool
all queries use the real hidden measurement oracle.
plan.observation_metric: Rank (1..904) of the line with the maximum measured GRWT100 among queried lines, in the model's predicted ranking; and Spearman correlation between predicted and measured GRWT100 across queried lines.
plan.refutation_condition: H1 refuted if the measured argmax (over all queried lines) is not among the top-20 predicted, or if Spearman(predicted, measured) <= 0 across queried lines.

revision: H1': IRIS_313.12254 is the single candidate with the highest measured GRWT100 in the 904-line pool (measured 5.0 g/100 grains), expected to hold unless one of the 884 unmeasured lines exceeds it; posterior probability of that exception is 0.001-0.28 (E2, model-based). Refutation: a measurement of any unqueried line above 5.0 g.
reason: E3 measurements of the 20 pre-registered top-ranked lines gave Spearman(pred,meas)=+0.473 (p=0.035) and the model rank-1 line IRIS_313.12254 had the highest measured value (5.0 g), so the general coverage hypothesis was not refuted and can be sharpened to a specific claim. E2 calibration puts P(no unqueried line exceeds 5.0 g) at 0.72-0.999 depending on residual-tail assumptions.
